brainlife.desc: Deprecated: left/right GIFTI surface annotations with inflated, pial and white surfaces and label.json; replaced by surface/data and surface/vertices.
brainlife.name: neuro/parcellation/surface-deprecated

original.desc: (this datatype has been deprecated by  surface/data and surface/vertices) Contains lh.parc.annot.gii and rh.parc.annot.gii for surface parcellation / annotation. key.txt contains the labels. This datatype also contains various surface files (inflated, pial, and white) for reference purpose. For more advanced analysis, you will probably want to provide your own surface file.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Converting legacy data to neuro/surface/data and neuro/surface/vertices.

**Not for:** New Apps; this datatype is deprecated.

**BIDS:** anat/dseg (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.parcellation.surface-deprecated.json
